install.title: Keep DoneToday close

install.iosHelp: Open DoneToday in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. The app needs an internet connection.
install.browserHelp: In your browser menu, look for Install app, Add to Home Screen or Create shortcut. If your browser does not offer it, try Chrome or Edge. The app needs an internet connection.
google.linkHelp: Link Google explicitly to sign in to this DoneToday account. Confirm your current password before continuing.
google.failed: Google sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
google.existingAccount: An account already uses this email. Sign in with your existing method, then link Google from Settings → Connected accounts.
google.linkFailed: Unable to link Google. Check your password and authenticator code. The Google account may already belong to another DoneToday account.
twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.help: Optional: add a code from your authenticator app to protect your account.
twoFactor.loginHelp: Enter your authenticator code or a recovery code to finish signing in.
twoFactor.loginError: Invalid code or expired sign-in attempt. Try again or restart sign-in.
twoFactor.recoveryHelp: Store these somewhere safe. Each code works once. New codes replace all previous ones. These codes will not be shown again.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR with your authenticator app, then enter its six-digit code.
twoFactor.error: Unable to complete this action. Check your password and code, or try again later.
auth.resetHelp: Enter your confirmed account email to receive a password reset link.
auth.resetSent: If a confirmed account with a password exists for this email, we have sent a reset link. Check your inbox.
auth.resetRequestError: Unable to request a reset link. Please try again.
auth.resetInvalid: This link is invalid or expired, or the password does not meet the requirements. Request a new link if needed.
auth.resetSuccess: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
auth.loginError: Unable to sign in. Check your email and password, confirm your email, or try again later.
auth.logoutError: Unable to sign out. Please try again.
auth.confirmHelp: Already registered but waiting for confirmation? Enter your email above to request another message.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters, including uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a special character.
auth.checkEmail: If this address can be registered, we have sent a confirmation email. Check your inbox.
auth.registerError: Please check your email and password, or try again later.
auth.rate: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
auth.emailUnavailable: Your account was saved, but email is unavailable. Try resending confirmation later.
auth.confirmed: Your email is confirmed. You can now sign in.
auth.confirmError: This link is invalid or expired. Request a new confirmation email.

motivation.02: A small step still moves you forward.
motivation.03: Showing up is something you can practice.
motivation.04: Give your next habit two minutes to begin.
motivation.05: Rest can be part of a steady routine.
motivation.06: Returning matters more than a perfect streak.
motivation.07: One page is a little more than yesterday.
motivation.08: Let a glass of water be a small act of care.
motivation.09: A short walk can make room for a fresh thought.
motivation.10: Build a routine that fits your real life.
motivation.11: Yesterday is information, not a verdict.
motivation.12: Choose one useful thing you can do next.
motivation.13: Every attempt can teach you how to continue.
motivation.14: Put what you need within easy reach.
motivation.15: Give one task your full attention for a moment.
motivation.16: Start with the time and energy you have today.
motivation.17: Keep one small promise to yourself today.
motivation.18: Make a little room for what matters to you.
motivation.19: Notice the effort that is easy to overlook.
motivation.20: Speak to yourself as you would to a friend.
motivation.21: A modest task completed deserves recognition.
motivation.22: Let patience have a place in your plans.
motivation.23: Adjusting a habit can help you keep it.
motivation.24: Decide when to begin, then make the first step easy.
motivation.25: Measure your progress against your own starting point.
motivation.26: A slower day can still hold meaningful progress.
motivation.27: Pause for a breath before your next step.
motivation.28: Your calendar can make space for care, too.
motivation.29: A few protected minutes can belong to what you value.
motivation.30: Ten focused minutes are a worthwhile beginning.
motivation.31: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
motivation.32: Prepare a small invitation for your next habit.
motivation.33: Simplify the routine before asking more of yourself.
motivation.34: You can begin again without explaining the pause.
motivation.35: Let your goal guide one practical action today.
motivation.37: Finishing something small can clear space in your mind.
motivation.38: Take a moment to appreciate what you did today.
motivation.39: A missed day does not erase the days you showed up.
motivation.40: Turn one good intention into one concrete action.
motivation.41: Give a skill enough time to feel unfamiliar.
motivation.42: Choose a version of your habit that suits your energy.
motivation.43: Caring for yourself is a reason to make time.
motivation.44: Leave some space in your schedule for being human.
motivation.45: Your routine does not need to win a race.
motivation.46: Bring your attention back to the step in front of you.
motivation.47: Saying no to one distraction can make room for a priority.
motivation.48: Practice the part you want to become more familiar.
motivation.49: A difficult effort can count even without a visible result.
motivation.50: A shorter session is an option, not a failure.
motivation.51: You can take a small step while feeling unsure.
motivation.52: Let curiosity help you find a routine that works.
motivation.53: A good routine leaves room for the rest of your life.
motivation.54: Asking for support can be your next useful step.
motivation.55: Keep a little evidence of the effort you are making.
motivation.56: Begin gently; confidence can arrive along the way.
motivation.57: Find a pace that gives you a reason to return.
motivation.58: Leave tomorrow one small thing already prepared.
motivation.59: Make room for enjoyment, not only achievement.
motivation.60: Another beginning is still a beginning worth making.
motivation.sourceSeneca: Seneca · Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter 1
motivation.61: Make tomorrow’s helpful choice easier to reach.
motivation.62: Build a repeatable process behind your goal.
motivation.63: Let small actions support your chosen identity.
motivation.64: Attach a clear cue to your routine.
motivation.65: Give yourself a reason to enjoy repeating.
motivation.66: Prefer steady improvement to an occasional overhaul.
motivation.67: Return quickly after a missed day.
motivation.68: Shape your surroundings to support your intention.
motivation.69: Make beginning easier before making the task bigger.
motivation.70: Notice where your routine is taking you.
motivation.inspiredAtomicHabits: Inspired by James Clear · Atomic Habits
